name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
summary: Across the sea, Alliance adventurers reach Ironforge seeking an explosive answer to the Venture Company in Stonetalon. Lomac Gearstrip agrees to brew Nitromirglyceronium if you bring him the needed alchemical reagents.

sections.title: A Volatile Solution
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle needs powerful explosives for his most advanced device against the Venture Company. He is stationed high in the craggy passes of the Stonetalon Mountains, far from his eccentric former colleague Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge. Lomac created Nitromirglyceronium, a compound so unstable and destructive that he finds the thought of anyone using it hilarious, no matter who gets blown apart.

sections.title: Potions for Pyrotechnics
sections.body: Lomac is eager to see goblin machinery, and perhaps you, blown to pieces, but his Ironforge workshop has run out of Nitromirglyceronium. Before brewing another batch, he asks for Minor Mana Potions and Elixirs of Minor Fortitude. The draughts supply the raw reagents for his mixture, and gathering them lets Lomac judge whether you have even a shred of respect for alchemy.

faq.answer: Lomac Gearstrip is an eccentric gnomish alchemist and tinkerer in Ironforge, the dwarven capital. He is Gaxim Rustfizzle's former colleague and created the volatile explosive Nitromirglyceronium.

faq.q: Why does Lomac want potions instead of standard engineering parts?
faq.answer: Lomac combines alchemy with his mechanical knowledge to make volatile reactions. Minor Mana Potions provide magical energy, while Elixirs of Minor Fortitude provide stabilizing bodily humors; both serve as base reagents for his Nitromirglyceronium mixture.

faq.q: Why send an adventurer all the way to Ironforge for this?
faq.answer: Gaxim Rustfizzle is isolated in the Stonetalon wilds, without access to heavy industrial or chemical workshops. Lomac Gearstrip in Ironforge is the only associate Gaxim trusts, or fears enough, to have an explosive potent enough for his most advanced device.
Nitromirglyceronium is Lomac Gearstrip's explosive chemical brew, notoriously volatile and, as Lomac calls it, his greatest creation.

faq.q: Is Lomac worried about the Venture Company or the forest?
faq.answer: Lomac has no concern for the Venture Company or the forest. He laughs at the idea of using explosives to save trees and wants to watch either the goblins or the courier get blasted to pieces.

faq.q: Do you need to be an alchemist to complete this task?
faq.answer: No. Lomac speaks of testing your alchemical skill, but he accepts reagents obtained through trade, merchants, or other crafters, as long as he gets the draughts his recipe requires.

angles.text: Lomac represents the unrestrained, madcap edge of gnomish ingenuity, putting chemical yield and theory ahead of safety or diplomatic caution.
The long journey from Stonetalon to Ironforge shows the strain of supporting remote Alliance outposts scattered across hostile Kalimdor.
When ordinary blasting powder fails against Venture Company steel, alchemy joined with engineering can bring far greater destruction.
